about_the_game:
Shards Reunited: Kintsugi - Expansion Pack DLC

Continue your journey of restoration with the Expansion Pack DLC for Shards Reunited: Kintsugi! This expansive addition brings 1200 new jigsaw puzzles, doubling the free base game’s 1200 puzzles to a grand total of 2400 puzzles. Perfect for dedicated solvers and art enthusiasts, it introduces fresh porcelain objects with intricate Japanese designs, from golden koi ponds to delicate bamboo groves, alongside exclusive achievements to earn.

The free base game delivers a complete experience with 1200 puzzles, colorful porcelain art, and calming music. The Expansion Pack DLC is a heartfelt addition for those craving more of Shards Reunited’s tranquil beauty. Restore more treasures and master the timeless art of Kintsugi!
